messages.text: Does cancelling with the card button before payout stop the refund?

Yes. Until a proposal is paid, you can cancel it with the button on its card (refund-policy/v2/approval). Your cancelled request for the ivory scarf won't be paid.

A message in the chat doesn't cancel a proposal, only the button does (refund-policy/v2/approval). A refund that has already been paid stays paid. That applies to your crimson scarf refund, receipt R-H471-0001.
